categories.main_business_segments: Maider Medical Industry Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent equipment for medical consumables. Its main product lines include safety infusion devices and blood purification equipment, with additional development in drug-device combination products and clinical testing consumables. The company also operates in the manufacturing of automated assembly lines for various medical consumables such as infusion sets, needles, insulin pens, dialysis equipment, and contact lenses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed multiple proprietary core technologies including high-speed multi-channel automatic feeding, medical soft catheter shaping, secondary plastic forming, curved surface solvent bonding, soft sticky medical consumables assembly, dialysis device packaging and assembly, and GMP data management platforms. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as modular design, system integration, and automated assembly lines tailored to the complex and customized needs of medical consumables production. The company also integrates AI-based visual inspection and control systems to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Maider Medical serves leading medical consumable manufacturers including Weigao, Contec, Sanxin Medical, Wuzhou Medical, Jiangxi Hongda, Gangan Medical, Terumo, and Fresenius Kabi. Its products cater to the medical consumables industry, particularly in safety infusion devices, blood purification consumables, and high-value consumables used in dialysis, biopharmaceuticals, medical aesthetics, and vaccine packaging. The company’s equipment supports both domestic and international markets, with a focus on customers requiring high precision and customized intelligent manufacturing solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Zhejiang Province, including Taizhou and Yuhuan. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Germany and Shanghai, serving both domestic and overseas markets. Export sales have increased, with overseas revenue accounting for over 6% of total sales, and the company actively expands its presence in Europe, the Americas, and developing countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Maider Medical operates upstream and midstream in the medical consumables supply chain by providing intelligent manufacturing equipment and automated assembly lines to medical consumable producers. It also selectively extends downstream by supplying certain high-value consumable components to customers, thereby deepening integration within the medical consumables production ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development, focusing on enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities for safety infusion and blood purification equipment. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 14.7% R&D-to-revenue ratio, developing new products for drug-device combinations and clinical testing consumables. Strategic initiatives include expanding production capacity for drug-device combination equipment, advancing digital factory solutions, and entering the contact lens manufacturing sector. The company emphasizes intellectual property protection and continuous technological upgrades to maintain market leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized intelligent manufacturing equipment and automated production lines to medical consumable manufacturers. The company also earns income from software development and related services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with contracts specifying technical solutions and installation confirmations as revenue recognition points.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Maider Medical is a leading domestic player in the intelligent equipment manufacturing sector for medical consumables, recognized as a pioneer with multiple national and provincial awards for first-in-China products. It holds the top market share in China for safety infusion and blood purification equipment. Competitors include both domestic and international manufacturers, but Maider’s strong R&D, comprehensive product portfolio, and established customer relationships provide a significant competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 274.85 million, a 42.77% decline from the previous year, primarily due to market demand fluctuations and increased competition. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 19.98 million, impacted by increased R&D and management expenses and goodwill impairment. Total assets stood at RMB 1.05 billion with net assets of RMB 810 million. Despite short-term setbacks, the company maintains substantial R&D investment and is executing strategic expansion projects to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Maider Medical emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product quality, and comprehensive service capabilities tailored to the complex and customized needs of medical consumable manufacturers. Its intelligent equipment improves production efficiency, product quality, and compliance with stringent regulatory standards. The company’s ability to provide integrated hardware and software solutions, along with strong after-sales support and close customer collaboration, differentiates it in the market and fosters long-term customer loyalty.
